newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy H1 PSBR seen around 25 trln lire - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Italy H1 PSBR seen around 25 trln lire - Treasury.

text.p: Italy's public sector borrowing requirement (PSBR) in the first six months of the year will be close to 25 trillion lire, Treasury undersecretary Giorgio Macciotta told reporters.
"It will be around 25 trillion lire, and therefore in line with the Maastricht Treaty criteria," he said.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday first half PSBR would be more than half the 52.25 trillion lire recorded in the corresponding period last year.

Italy is committed to reducing the ratio between its budget deficit and gross domestic product to the three percent required by the Maastricht Treaty for first wave membership of Europe's planned single currency from 6.7 percent in 1996.
Italy's cumulative PSBR was around 42.0 trillion lire at end-April 1997 compared with 71.673 trillion at end-April 1996.
